description: We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who love space exploration, game design, and coding. Our project is an interactive space mission design game where players plan real-world-inspired missions: choosing destinations, spacecraft, budgets, fuel, and crew while managing risks. It turns NASA science into hands-on learning. We bring skills in programming, creative design, and storytelling. We're looking for teammates with experience in game development (Unity/Godot/JavaScript), 3D art or UI/UX
